tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Layer5 teal, the primary brand fill: Crowhorn icon body, Major's body, primary button fills, large display accents. A fill, never small text on light grounds (2.6:1 on white); text on it is on-teal.

tokens.name: teal-bright
tokens.usage: Layer5 Caribbean green: Major's hackle mane, highlights, accent strokes. On dark grounds it is the link and focus colour (8.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: teal-shade
tokens.usage: Cel shading on illustration (wings, thigh fluff, lower body) and the hover state of teal fills.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Text-safe teal for light grounds: links and focus on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (4.9:1 or better). Also Major's tail feathers.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Layer5 charcoal: the wordmark ink on light grounds, the outline on every Major illustration, the horn mouthpiece. Text on charcoal is white (9.3:1).

tokens.name: near-black
tokens.usage: Deepest ink and the dark ground: on-dark logo versions, banners, the app icon dark variant.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Layer5 yellow, the accent: the horn bell, medals, epaulettes, the sunrise disc behind Major. Keep it under a tenth of any layout. Never text on light grounds (1.7:1); text on it is on-yellow.

tokens.name: yellow-shade
tokens.usage: Shading on yellow: the inside of the horn bell, medal stars, leg scales.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Major's comb and wattle, and the comb on the Crowhorn mark. Reserved for the rooster: never a UI state, button or text colour.

tokens.name: coral-shade
tokens.usage: Shading on coral: wattle folds and the inside of Major's open beak.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Warm relief: badge and avatar backgrounds, Major's earlobe, and the keyline around Major on dark grounds.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Major's puffed chest bib. Illustration only.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warm accent from the drill-sergeant direction: Major's hackle and saddle feathers, the head of the Sergeant badge (Concept I). Illustration and logo art only; never text.

tokens.name: khaki
tokens.usage: The campaign hat's felt in Concepts G and I and in mascot art. Illustration and logo art only.

tokens.name: khaki-shade
tokens.usage: Shadow side of the campaign hat crown and brim.

tokens.name: leather
tokens.usage: The campaign hat's band.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Eye whites, on-dark wordmark, text on charcoal and near-black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, code blocks and tiles that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Teal relief: the ground behind mascot art, selected rows, callouts.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (4.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-wordmark
tokens.usage: Headlines and the Blowhorn wordmark: charcoal on light grounds (8.6:1 on surface-raised), white on dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and interactive text on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (4.9:1 light, 6.4:1 dark, or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders: 3.4:1 or better on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px offset in the ground colour; 4.9:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on teal (6.2:1) and teal-bright (8.5:1) fills. Never white on teal.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on yellow fills (9.4:1).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: One message out, many ears in.
styles.usage: Hero headlines on marketing pages and banners. One per page.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: One message goes in. Every profile your community runs hears it.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Blowhorn reposts and amplifies across every profile, on autopilot.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, CLI, IDs, URLs like blowhorn.layer5.io.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase metric labels, eyebrows and sheet captions. Set the text in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical), list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards; padding of large tiles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding inside panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding, banner margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, menus, speech-bubble shapes in UI.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Mascot art tiles and marketing cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and tags.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon corner on the 1024 tile (230px).

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The loud sticker shadow: marketing cards, Major callouts, one hero button. Never on dense UI.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs.

tokens.name: stroke-mascot
tokens.usage: Charcoal outline on Major art drawn on a 420px-tall canvas (about 1.1% of his height). Scale it with the art, never thinner than 1.5px.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: UI icon stroke on a 24px grid (lucide-react and the platform marks), round caps and joins.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers in line and line-strong.
